scientific_integrity: Analytical spectral result with two independent numerical corroborations; no external verification or certification represented.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the natural weighted Sturm-Liouville realization of the orbit Fokker-Planck generator, not to the entire finite-dimensional quantum Liouvillian.
The critical ratio limit is not uniform in spin size and supplies no simultaneous critical-drive/thermodynamic-limit estimate.
The original foundational cooperative-fluorescence papers could not be completely inspected; priority remains best-knowledge rather than independently established.
title: A sharp Hardy-limit law for orbit-selecting diffusion in a dissipative time crystal
